name: What is a 1031 exchange and how can it benefit my exit strategy?

mainEntity.name: What is a 1031 exchange and how can it benefit my exit strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: A 1031 exchange allows you to defer capital gains taxes when you sell an investment property and reinvest the proceeds into a similar 'like-kind' property within a specific timeframe. This can be a powerful tool for growing your real estate portfolio without immediate tax implications. To successfully execute a 1031 exchange, you must identify potential replacement properties, possibly within areas like Palm Beach or Orange County, within 45 days of closing on the relinquished property.
acceptedAnswer.description: A 1031 exchange defers capital gains taxes by reinvesting sale proceeds into a 'like-kind' property within a set timeframe.
